text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Yo, Dober-senpai!
Please come be in my UmaTok video~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If wicked-cute Pandora-chan teams up with
the cool beauty Dober-senpai,
it's guaranteed to go viral! Tens of thousands of likes, easy♡

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry. Doing flashy stuff like UmaTok...
it's really not for me...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, no wayyy... *sniff*.
Is it really a no-go? Pretty please~...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Then, then, how about brainstorming! If you just
help me bounce ideas around for a bit, that's totally fine!
That works, right? Right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ghk... I-If it's just that much, well, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—So, why are we at a café?
What happened to brainstorming video ideas?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, groaning and racking our brains in a classroom
is totally boring, right? We'll definitely come up with way better ideas
while munching on sweets♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Geez... You just wanted
to eat sweets yourself, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't say that. Look, look,
let's splurge on treats♪
It's my treat today!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
How about this Ω Royal Pretty Parfait?
It looks like it packed every single sweet in the universe into one,
totally insane♡

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-No... It looks impressive, but
I think I'll just stick to coffee.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Product review videos are an absolute classic, after all♪
Whoaaa~♡ Those shoes are crazy cute~♡
I wonder if they have my size~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait. Those are for sprints, you know?
The design is nice, but you need to pick shoes
that actually suit your style.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way, design is super important!
It totally changes your motivation♪
Btw, which ones would you pick, Dober-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: If it were me... maybe these?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a li~ttle plain, but
totally cool and chic!
As expected of Dober-senpai, you've got great taste~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Many many, oh yeah!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hyuu! Now we're talking!
Come on, come on, sing with me, Dober-senpai~♡

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll pass.
Why don't you sing whatever you want, Pandora?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Okaay. In that case, next up
is a duet song~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's no fun singing a duet all by myself,
so pretty please help me out~♡

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Fine, but only one song, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Phew~, that was soo~ much fun,
Dober-senpai♡

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, we didn't come up with any video ideas at all.
...Is that really okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it, did I say something like that?
Well, I got to see some great stuff instead,
so we're totally even~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Great... stuff...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Look, check this out.
Doesn't this look crazy cute?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Eh...?
W-When did you take videos!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Sowwyy~♡
I just took some casual clips to see if I could get any aesthetic shots, but—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
At the café, your eyes kept darting over
to the super sugary menu items♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And the shoes you picked, Dober-senpai,
if you look closely, they secretly have a discreet flower pattern on them♡

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: S-Stop, h-hey, cut it out...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And, and! Look at this, you
shyly shaking the maracas bit by bit!
It's wicked cute~♡

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright, I get it, I get it,
so just stop already!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Man, I have mad respect for cool Dober-senpai,
but it's such a waste that nobody knows
this cute side of you~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, since we're here, why don't we just
make a video showcasing that side of you!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you there, Trainer!♡
You think that's a great idea too, right? Right?

Apparently, she wants to make a video showcasing
the unseen side of Mejiro Dober, but—
choice_data_list: Fans would probably love seeing a side of you they don't know.
Maybe she only showed that side because it was you?
Maybe she only showed that side because it was you?

text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she wants to make a video showcasing
the unseen side of Mejiro Dober, but—
choice_data_list: Fans would probably love seeing a side of you they don't know.
Maybe she only showed that side because it was you?
Maybe she only showed that side because it was you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
G-Geez, don't say unnecessary things!
Pandora's going to take you seriously!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that...
No way, it's just too embarrassing after all!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eh, for real, Dober-senpai?
Does that mean you're totally in love with meee!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not going out of my way
to say something like that... geez!
